audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradict the packet, and every one also contradicts its own why: whys[0] 'even farm start' vs win[0]='Graves'; whys[1]/[2]/[3]/[5] all describe Graves winning while win[1]/[2]/[3]/[5] say Skill or Wukong; whys[6] 'even the fight' vs win[6]='Wukong'.
audit.why: Packet chart: Skill, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Skill. The graves__wukong mirror is already set to it with ratings 5/7/7/7/7/7/5 from his side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in matched pairs; ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's — 5/3/3/3/3/3/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] credits Graves's tankiness to 'his passive armor stacking'. New Destiny grants no resistances — it is the shotgun ammo/reload system. The armour and MR come from Quickdraw's True Grit, and hitting basic attacks lowers Quickdraw's cooldown and refreshes the resistances.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost... If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.' Riot's P text is purely about ammo and bullets.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw (16/15/14/13/12s) is both his dash and his resistances, and autos refresh it — so it is rarely down for long. Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate ability-name failures. (1) Graves's Q is called 'Buckshot' in four places — it is End of the Line. (2) 'End of the Line (E)' is used for his dash in spikes[1] and wants.foe[2] — the dash is Quickdraw, so the page uses the real Q name on the wrong slot. (3) Smoke Screen is called a 'blind' in five places; Riot's text describes a cloud that REDUCES SIGHT RANGE and applies magic damage plus a brief slow — no blind appears in it.
audit.why: Riot text, Q: 'Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain', 925 range, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s. E: 'Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost.' W: 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly', 26/24/22/20/18s.
audit.corrected: Q is End of the Line, 13s at rank 1, detonates on terrain contact. The dash is Quickdraw. Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — 26s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions the single biggest laning quirk in Graves's kit: his attacks fire four bullets that CANNOT PASS THROUGH UNITS.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.' Standing with the minion wave between you and Graves denies most of his auto damage outright — the one free defensive tool in a lane he otherwise owns.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2] and the ability-interactions box: keep the wave between you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw is named page-wide as the cooldown to punish, with no number and no mention that autos reduce it.
audit.why: 16/15/14/13/12s, but 'hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill' — so it comes back far faster than the printed number in a trade.

notes: This was the worst page in my slice for ability names. Graves's Q was called 'Buckshot' four times (it is End of the Line), and his dash was called 'End of the Line (E)' twice — so the page used a real ability name on the wrong slot, which reads as authoritative and is worse than a made-up word. Smoke Screen was called a blind five times; Riot's text describes reduced sight range plus a brief slow and says nothing about blinding, so I wrote what the text says rather than assert or deny a blind. Also corrected 'passive armor stacking' — New Destiny is the ammo system; the resistances are Quickdraw's True Grit, refreshed by basic attacks. Added the passive's bullets-cannot-pass-through-units property, which is the one free defensive tool in this lane and appeared nowhere on the page. Level chart: six rows disagreed with the packet and with their own whys; flipped to match the graves__wukong mirror with inverse ratings.
